governing_arc: Product -> world-building chapter -> finished hero monument
story_definition: The heroes are the finished footprint. Product chapters are the visual origin story that shows how each hero was built.
rules: The product is the protagonist of every scene.
The collection hero is the completed destination and visual footprint.
Chapter scenes reveal how the hero's materials, symbols, light, and architecture came together.
A chapter may foreshadow hero motifs but must not merely reproduce the hero.
Every environment must respond physically and narratively to the worn product.

signature.hero_endpoint: Two finished Signature monuments frame Golden Gate light and the Bay crossing.
signature.product_role: The wearer carries the first house mark from the Oakland atelier across the water.

hero_aspect_chapters.approved_text_edit: Keep SkyyRose only; omit THE, COLLECTION, the freestanding statue legs, and the source background.
hero_aspect_chapters.treatment: Use the clean transparent founder-supplied gold SkyyRose script and integrated rose sculpture as the font monument inside the first Oakland atelier. Preserve its exact script, rose, metallic finish, and proportions as one protected object. THE, COLLECTION, the freestanding statue legs, and source background are intentionally omitted by founder direction. Redrawing, re-lettering, simplification, recoloring, or generated substitution is forbidden.
hero_aspect_chapters.integration: The verified Windbreaker Set model stands naturally in the atelier light; the complete founder-supplied statue belongs to the room, remains readable, and does not overlap or alter the garment.

hero_aspect_chapters.treatment: Carry forward the Golden Gate and Bay landscape, water, fog, dusk light, and reflected rose-gold lines without either finished hero monument.
hero_aspect_chapters.integration: The verified Sherpa Jacket model occupies a believable waterfront overlook with correct contact shadow, scale, depth, and environmental light.

hero_aspect_chapters.treatment: Use the exact founder-supplied rose-gold SR monogram graphic as a protected sculptural house mark. It may become architecture or a monument, but the supplied RGBA pixels, silhouette, metallic palette, letterform, flourish, leaves, and internal rose remain exact; never ask a generator to redraw it.
hero_aspect_chapters.integration: The verified Bay Bridge Shirt model is the foreground protagonist; the SR graphic sits in the world as a separate environmental element and never replaces or contaminates the shirt artwork.

motif_evolution: raw black stone and rose-gold drafting materials
bridge geometry and reflected water lines
the completed Signature and SR monuments
chapter_arc: The product is authored inside the first Oakland atelier.
The wearer carries it across the Bay as the house language gains scale.
The bridge, water, and rose-gold mark resolve into the finished hero monuments.

black-rose.hero_endpoint: The Black Rose wordmark and star-and-rose monuments hold court beneath a Bay Bridge moon.
black-rose.product_role: The wearer enters protected, and the garden transforms around the garment's contrast, embroidery, and guarded elegance.

hero_aspect_chapters.treatment: Use the exact Black Rose font-and-rose statue pixels extracted directly from the approved hero master. Preserve the identical letterforms, 3D silver depth, backing rails, Collection line, rose, and proportions. Do not use a flat lockup, redraw the lettering, or generate substitute fragments.
hero_aspect_chapters.integration: The verified Crewneck model is naturally placed in front of the type architecture. Preserve the crewneck's raised embossed black-white-grey chest relief and white ribbed trim; never reinterpret it as embroidery.

hero_aspect_chapters.treatment: Use the open Oakland waterfront, Bay Bridge, water reflections, and full-moon atmosphere without the finished font or star monument.
hero_aspect_chapters.product_binding: br-006 protected founder footage and verified on_model_front
hero_aspect_chapters.integration: The Black Rose Sherpa Bomber remains the authentic product layer in the open-air world. The source footage and garment pixels are never AI-repainted.

hero_aspect_chapters.founder_identity_confirmation: The heart-shaped base is part of the authentic graphic and must remain.
hero_aspect_chapters.treatment: Use the exact authentic black-and-silver star, single rose, leaves, loose leaves, and heart-shaped base as the environmental monument. Preserve the complete source pixels and silhouette; do not substitute the three-rose garment cluster, remove or replace the heart base, or regenerate the graphic.
hero_aspect_chapters.product_binding: br-001 on_model_front until a different Black Rose non-Jersey on-model source passes the fidelity gate
hero_aspect_chapters.integration: The protected model remains physically separate from the star graphic, with credible scale, floor contact, reflections, and edge light.

motif_evolution: wrought-iron threshold, wet stone, and first black roses
protective midnight architecture and silver edge light

chapter_arc: The product crosses the forbidden garden threshold.
The waterfront monument begins around protection, depth, restrained light, and authentic garment memory.
The rose, star, bridge, and moon resolve into the finished hero court.

hero-origin-film-br-006.treatment: Founder-shot footage loops silently as the face of a large open-air film monument while a verified on-model back view reveals the large center-back embroidery.
hero-origin-film-br-006.continuity: The real garment remains the product truth; Bay Bridge light, moon, forged rose metalwork, black stone, and unfinished star rays build around it toward the hero endpoint.

love-hurts.hero_endpoint: The Love Hurts script and cracked-heart star face the Beast and the protected rose across a crimson aisle.
love-hurts.product_role: The wearer carries tenderness as armor through damage, distance, and devotion.
motif_evolution: first thorns, petals, and fractured red reflections
the Beast's distance from the rose under glass

chapter_arc: The product enters the cathedral while the wound is still exposed.
The wearer crosses the chamber where distance becomes protection.
The heart, thorns, script, and rose resolve into the finished hero aisle.

kids-capsule.product_role: The child creates the room through play, movement, and confidence rather than waiting to inherit it.

a runway formed by the child's movement

The child's movement turns the room into a first runway.
The runway, crown, rose-gold light, and throne resolve into the finished hero.
